# Google Maps Platform Multi-Framework Web Samples

> 15 Playwright-verified, zero-deprecation, ToS-compliant Google Maps Platform web solutions implemented across 8 standalone frameworks (120 complete apps, 0 console errors). Every solution lives at `./<solution-id>/<framework>/`.

## Agent Guides & Catalogs

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Primary 1-hop agent router with overlap disambiguation tables and UI/geo pattern lookup.
- [BY_API.md](./BY_API.md): REST header/CORS transport matrix, JS-vs-REST naming cheatsheet, common error fixes, and legacy-to-modern migration table.
- [BY_FRAMEWORK.md](./BY_FRAMEWORK.md): Stack-specific idioms, compiler configs, and runtime gotchas for all 8 frameworks.
- [catalog.json](./catalog.json): Machine-readable solution-level manifest with canonical API index and Demo Key coverage.
- [INDEX.md](./INDEX.md): Compact master table linking all solutions, frameworks, screenshots, and verification reports.
- [README.md](./README.md): Category overview, Maps Demo Key vs. Cloud Billing Key table, and GMP Terms of Service appendix.
- [Official Google Maps Platform Agent Skills](https://github.com/googlemaps/agent-skills): Installable coding-agent skills, product guides, and compliance checks (`npx skills add googlemaps/agent-skills`).

## Frameworks (Available in Every Solution at `./<solution-id>/<slug>/`)

- `static-vanilla-js`: Zero-bundler ES modules + `@googlemaps/js-api-loader` + `server.mjs` (`/env-config.js`, 6/15 proxy `/api/*`).
- `react-vite`: React + Vite + TS + `@vis.gl/react-google-maps` (`Map as GoogleMap`, 3/15 use Vite middleware `/api/*`).
- `nextjs`: Next.js App Router + TS + `'use client'` `@vis.gl/react-google-maps` + Server Route Handlers (`X-Goog-FieldMask`).
- `sveltekit`: SvelteKit + TS + `onMount` SSR guard + `@googlemaps/js-api-loader` (9/15 include `+server.ts` BFF routes).
- `vue-vite`: Vue 3 + Vite + TS + `isCustomElement` for `<gmp-*>` + `@googlemaps/js-api-loader` (1/15 uses Vite proxy).
- `angular`: Angular Standalone + TS + `@angular/google-maps` + `CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA` + `serve-dist.mjs` (6/15 proxy `/api/*`).
- `python-fastapi`: Python FastAPI async BFF (`httpx`, Pydantic v2, `127.0.0.1`) + zero-bundler web UI (`/api/config`).
- `nodejs-web`: Node.js + Express + TypeScript BFF (`dist/server.js`, `127.0.0.1`) + interactive web UI.

## Solutions

- [3d-trail-explorer — Photorealistic 3D Map Explorer, Camera Tour & 3D Trail Route](./3d-trail-explorer/AGENTS.md) ([README](./3d-trail-explorer/README.md)): [Advanced Spatial Analytics & 3D] ONLY Photorealistic 3D (`<gmp-map-3d>` / `Map3DElement`) app; extruded red `Polyline3DElement`, `Marker3DInteractiveElement` + `PopoverElement`, `flyCameraTo` chapter tour, Elevation profile. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Photorealistic 3D, Places (New), Elevation. (Cloud Key needed (Elevation API (REST)))
- [complete-heatmap — Disaster Hazard Heatmap, Civic Incident & Safe Shelter Router](./complete-heatmap/AGENTS.md) ([README](./complete-heatmap/README.md)): [Environmental & Civic Intelligence] deck.gl `HeatmapLayer` (replaces deprecated Maps JS `HeatmapLayer`) + flood polygon + hazard-avoiding shelter route + map-click Weather/Elevation/Geocode incident reporter. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Routes API, Geocoding, Elevation, Weather API, deck.gl. (Cloud Key needed (Elevation API (REST)))
- [driving-and-geofencing — Field Workforce Geofenced Attendance & Site Audit Router](./driving-and-geofencing/AGENTS.md) ([README](./driving-and-geofencing/README.md)): [Logistics, Dispatch & Tracking] Terra Draw polygon geofence editor (replaces `DrawingManager`) + worker GPS inside/outside `containsLocation` clock-in + Geocoding v4 reverse geocode + `optimizeWaypointOrder` multi-stop audit route. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Routes API, Geocoding, Terra Draw. (Demo Key OK)
- [environmental-dashboard — Hyperlocal Weather, Air Quality, Pollen & Solar Dashboard](./environmental-dashboard/AGENTS.md) ([README](./environmental-dashboard/README.md)): [Environmental & Civic Intelligence] Weather API (current + forecast) + Air Quality API (AQI + WebGL-free `ImageMapType` `US_AQI` heatmap tiles) + Pollen API + Solar API rooftop `buildingInsights:findClosest` (with 404 handling). APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Geocoding, Weather API, Air Quality, Pollen API, Solar API. (Cloud Key needed (Air Quality API, Pollen API, Solar API))
- [ev-charging-map-and-dispatch — On-Demand Local Services & EV Roadside Dispatch](./ev-charging-map-and-dispatch/AGENTS.md) ([README](./ev-charging-map-and-dispatch/README.md)): [Local Discovery & Storefronts] Draggable user pin with reverse geocode + configurable 5–15 km search ring + `Place.searchNearby` (`evChargeOptions`) + driving ETA ranking & turn-by-turn dispatch route. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Routes API, Route Matrix, Geocoding. (Demo Key OK)
- [itinerary-planner — Multi-Day Trip Itinerary Planner, Hotels & Time Zone Hub](./itinerary-planner/AGENTS.md) ([README](./itinerary-planner/README.md)): [Travel, Navigation & Itineraries] Multi-day Tokyo trip tabs + Time Zone API local clock/UTC offset + numbered day-colored markers + `optimizeWaypointOrder` daily route + Places photos & Street View preview. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Routes API, Street View, Time Zone. (Cloud Key needed (Time Zone API))
- [live-order-tracking — On-Demand Delivery Checkout, Zone Validation & Live Tracker](./live-order-tracking/AGENTS.md) ([README](./live-order-tracking/README.md)): [Logistics, Dispatch & Tracking] Address Validation API (deliverability + USPS CASS) + delivery polygon & 8 km fee check + smoothly animated courier `AdvancedMarkerElement` + Maps Static API PNG receipt proxy. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Routes API, Geocoding, Address Validation, Maps Static. (Cloud Key needed (Address Validation API, Maps Static API))
- [logistics-and-routing — Fleet Telematics, Road-Snapped GPS & Dispatch Dashboard](./logistics-and-routing/AGENTS.md) ([README](./logistics-and-routing/README.md)): [Logistics, Dispatch & Tracking] Roads API `snapToRoads` (raw noisy GPS vs. road-snapped polyline) + `TrafficLayer` + status-coded fleet markers (En Route/Delayed/Idle) + depot-to-hub `RouteMatrix`. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Routes API, Route Matrix, Roads API. (Cloud Key needed (Roads API))
- [neighborhood-discovery — Hyperlocal Neighborhood Directory & Spot Mapper](./neighborhood-discovery/AGENTS.md) ([README](./neighborhood-discovery/README.md)): [Local Discovery & Storefronts] 5 km category `Place.searchNearby` (restaurants/cafes/museums/parks) + side-by-side place comparison drawer (ratings, hours, reviews, photo proxy) + map-click reverse-geocode spot pinning. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Geocoding. (Demo Key OK)
- [real-estate — Split-Screen Real Estate Search, Parcel Polygon & Commute Explorer](./real-estate/AGENTS.md) ([README](./real-estate/README.md)): [Real Estate & Property Mapping] Zillow-style split screen + custom HTML price-pill `AdvancedMarkerElement` with bidirectional hover sync + `MarkerClusterer` + cadastral parcel polygons + Terra Draw search-area filter + Street View + `RouteMatrix` commute times. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Routes API, Route Matrix, Geocoding, Street View, MarkerClusterer, Terra Draw. (Demo Key OK)
- [ridesharing-and-tracker — Rideshare Booking, Fare Estimator & Live Driver Tracking](./ridesharing-and-tracker/AGENTS.md) ([README](./ridesharing-and-tracker/README.md)): [Logistics, Dispatch & Tracking] Fastest vs. Eco-Friendly (`FUEL_EFFICIENT` / `FUEL_CONSUMPTION`) side-by-side route comparison + Economy/Comfort/Green fare estimator + closest-driver dispatch & animated marker along polyline. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Routes API, Eco-Routing, Route Matrix. (Demo Key OK)
- [spatial-intelligence — Enterprise GIS Workbench, GeoJSON Zones & Deck.gl Analytics](./spatial-intelligence/AGENTS.md) ([README](./spatial-intelligence/README.md)): [Advanced Spatial Analytics & 3D] 2D Enterprise Web GIS workbench: basemap switcher (roadmap/satellite/hybrid/terrain) + GeoJSON Data Layer styled by capacity + deck.gl `ScatterplotLayer`/`HexagonLayer` + Terra Draw study-zone point filter + Elevation. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Elevation, deck.gl, Terra Draw. (Cloud Key needed (Elevation API (REST)))
- [store-locator — Multi-Branch Store, ATM & Inventory Locator](./store-locator/AGENTS.md) ([README](./store-locator/README.md)): [Local Discovery & Storefronts] Dense NYC multi-branch locator with `@googlemaps/markerclusterer` (custom `AdvancedMarkerElement` cluster renderer) + type/inventory filters + `RouteMatrix` ETAs + 'Route to Fastest' branch. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Routes API, Route Matrix, Geocoding, MarkerClusterer. (Demo Key OK)
- [storefront-sample — Single-Venue Storefront, Booking & Get Directions Hub](./storefront-sample/AGENTS.md) ([README](./storefront-sample/README.md)): [Local Discovery & Storefronts] Single-venue clinic booking hub + branded `AdvancedMarkerElement` + toggleable service-area `Circle` + synchronized `StreetViewPanorama` entrance + live Places reviews/hours/photo proxy + Driving/Transit/Walking directions. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Routes API, Street View. (Demo Key OK)
- [travel-route-comparator — Multi-Modal Commute Comparator & Trail Elevation Tracker](./travel-route-comparator/AGENTS.md) ([README](./travel-route-comparator/README.md)): [Travel, Navigation & Itineraries] 4-mode commute comparator (Driving/Cycling/Walking/Transit) + Avoid Tolls/Highways & Eco-Friendly toggles + `BicyclingLayer` + Elevation API path profile chart synced with map hover marker. APIs: Maps JS 2D, Places (New), Routes API, Eco-Routing, Elevation. (Cloud Key needed (Elevation API (REST)))
